caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher centered on a plain, light-colored background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of grey, giving it a monochromatic appearance, with shading that suggests a reflective and smooth surface. The pitcher has a rounded, bulbous body, a pronounced spout with an ornate edge, and a handle decorated with subtle ornamental patterns. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a small stamp or emblem that reads "NEW JERSEY CHINA POTTERY CO," accompanied by a simple illustration of two figures holding a jug between them. In the lower right corner, the name "Jos Sudek" is handwritten. The pitcher is the only object in the composition, and it is positioned within a faint rectangular border that frames the entire image.
title: Pitcher
